title: Delicious Foods & Tasty Drinks
description: A mod that adds new Foods, new Plants and even a Chef's Uniform...

### Description:
For the cooking aficionados out there, would you enjoy Minecraft a little bit more if it had more elaborate cooking recipes and different types of foods?
If that's the case, then "Delicious Foods & Tasty Drinks" is for you. 

This Mod adds 21 new Ingredients that you will have to find in different biomes all over the world or simply craft. 

Besides that, all the food items are divided into new categories, depending on how much food and saturation they replenish:

The "_Food_" category has 9 different types of food items, which are the easiest to craft and are the least replenishing foods in the mod.

The "_Snack_" category is compiled of 9 different types of food items, and it is the middle ground, same logic, a bit more difficult to make, and they also have a better pay-off than the previous ones.

And finally, the "_Meal_" category, which ironically has 15 different types of food items, and is the most complicated but rewarding food category to craft.

But if that wasn't enough for you, this mod also presents an entirely new concept of food items, which are the "_Drinks & Beverages_", which, instead of replenishing food, replenish saturation. Drinks are the easiest and least rewarding, and Beverages are the hardest and most rewarding of the type. 

And as the cherry on top, the mod also adds a new craftable set of armor, which is "the Chef's Uniform", which is useless in combat but instead will grant you XP every time you craft an elaborate recipe or drink.

So if you wanna go more in depth with the concepts that I am talking to you about, then how about you enter the wiki to see the new ingredients, the new natural plants and blocks that spawn in the world, the new cooking recipes, different types of food, and obviously, the new armor.

And if it convinced you, I hope you truly enjoy downloading it for your next world.
